_comment: MCP servers, as configured in ~/.claude.json under mcpServers.
Credentials are referenced by environment variable and never inlined.
Note: ${VAR} is expanded from the environment of the Claude Code process,
not from an interactive shell. Launching the app from the macOS GUI rather
than a login shell means the var is unset and the header ships literally,
which GitHub rejects as 'Authorization header is badly formatted'.
